what: floors must span the entire structure footprint — no strip of terrain between the floor edge and the wall's inner face
audit: one-off scene-graph audit (scripts/_floor-audit.mjs, deleted): every role:"floor" block measured against its structure's userData.w/d via BoxGeometry parameters. Before: ranchHouse/ranchEll/bunkhouse were 0.5 short (0.25 m gap per side), huntingCabin 0.44 short (0.22 m per side). After: all FULL.
bunkhouse-before.png: bunkhouse interior before the fix — the floor stops short of the walls (terrain strip along the wall base)
bunkhouse-after.png: same vantage after — floorboards run wall-to-wall
note: town-lot floors (interiors.js addShell) already met their walls exactly because addShell insets its walls half a thickness from the footprint; they were extended to the full footprint anyway so the rule is uniform and the new check-buildings invariant covers them
